text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bike Form! Strong Daaash!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohhh!?)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What is this...!? What an incredible burst 
of speed! It's truly beyond all 
expectations!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Did you see thaaat?! Justice Biko is here! 
Just you wait, Bono!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus seized victory with 
eye-opening sharpness. After that—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a shocker!? Hishi Akebono wins with a 
new Japanese record!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She can't even be called a dark horse 
anymore! It's not just her size—her sheer 
presence is massive!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It turned out sooo buono~☆ Just wait right 
there, Biko-chan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono also won her prep race with 
flying colors. Expectations for the 
Sprinters Stakes are rising higher and 
higher.

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! Is she the one? The Umamusume who 
taught you action choreography?"

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Director. That's Biko Pegasus. And 
her rival there is Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Those two are normally the best of 
friends!

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, small & big! Just like a 
cartoon... You're like a duo straight out 
of a kids' anime.

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text:
Once you become a star, we might be able 
to make their story into a movie someday.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: ââ!! That would be wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best! So that one day, I can 
make it a reality!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Come on Trainer, it's finally the climax. 
The two-part finale of Justice Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Never thought the Big Boss standing in my 
way would turn out to be Bono.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's truly like a drama...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Honestly, I wanna praise you for 
keeping up so well.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't do that... I'm the Hero, 
and she's the Great Leader...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way I can let them catch up. 
And then—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want the kids watching my race somewhere 
out there to feel that way too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I want to grow up to be a hero like 
Justice Biko!" they said!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Trainer! I won't back down 
a single step!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day has finally come to stand side by 
side on the racetrack with Hishi Akebono, 
who has always been by my side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"How will Biko Pegasus feel on the stage 
of the Sprinters Stakes?"
